2608.13453.title: UniTexture: Cross-Task Universal Adversarial Textures for Vision-Language-Action Models
2608.13453.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as generalist robotic policies capable of following diverse language instructions and performing a wide range of manipulation tasks. However, their direct control over embodied agents also exposes them to adversarial interference that may cause unsafe physical behaviors. Existing attacks on robotic policies are typically optimized for a single task or instruction, leaving the cross-task vulnerabilities of multitask VLAs largely unexplored. We introduce UniTexture, a cross-task universal adversarial texture attack that uses a single textured 3D object to induce targeted deviations in VLA action predictions across multiple tasks. UniTexture backpropagates gradients from the policy's action outputs to surface texture parameters through a differentiable renderer. It jointly optimizes the shared texture over a distribution of tasks, instructions, states, and viewpoints using a targeted action-space objective, steering predicted actions toward attacker-defined targets without optimizing a separate texture for each task. We evaluate UniTexture on OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$ across diverse manipulation tasks and multiple evaluation settings. UniTexture reduces the mean task success rate from 90.0% under benign conditions to 48.4% under attack, induces target-aligned action shifts, and further exhibits cross-suite and cross-model transfer without re-optimization. Together, these findings reveal shared cross-task vulnerabilities in multitask VLAs that can be systematically exploited through a single adversarial surface texture.
2608.13453.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型已經出現，作為能夠遵循多樣化語言指令並執行廣泛操作任務的通用機器人策略。<lb/>然而，它們對具身代理的直接控制也使它們暴露於可能導致不安全物理行為的對抗性干擾中。<lb/>現有的機器人政策攻擊通常針對單一任務或指令進行優化，這使得多任務 VLA 的跨任務脆弱性大多未被探索。<lb/>我們介紹了 UniTexture，一種跨任務的通用對抗性紋理攻擊，使用單一的紋理 3D 物體在多個任務中引發 VLA 行動預測的目標偏差。<lb/>UniTexture 通過可微分渲染器將政策的行動輸出反向傳播到表面紋理參數。<lb/>它使用目標行動空間目標，聯合優化在任務、指令、狀態和視角的分佈上共享的紋理，將預測的行動引導至攻擊者定義的目標，而無需為每個任務優化單獨的紋理。<lb/>我們在 OpenVLA 和 $π_{0.5}$ 上評估了 UniTexture，涵蓋多樣的操作任務和多個評估設置。<lb/>UniTexture 將在良性條件下的平均任務成功率從 90.0% 降低至 48.4% 在攻擊下，誘導目標對齊的行動變化，並進一步顯示出跨套件和跨模型的轉移，而無需重新優化。<lb/>這些發現共同揭示了多任務 VLA 中的共享跨任務脆弱性，可以通過單一的對抗性表面紋理進行系統性利用。
